# NPY interoperability fixtures

`numpy_f64_c_order.npy` and `numpy_u64_indices.npy` are generated by NumPy
with `generate_fixtures.py`. Rust tests read both files.

Use the repository Python environment to regenerate fixtures and verify Rust
output:

```sh
uv venv .venv-code --python 3.12
uv pip install --python .venv-code/bin/python numpy
uv run --python .venv-code/bin/python tests/fixtures/npy/generate_fixtures.py
cargo run --release --no-default-features --features npy --example npy_interop_fixture -- /path/to/rust-output.npy
uv run --python .venv-code/bin/python tests/fixtures/npy/generate_fixtures.py verify /path/to/rust-output.npy
```
